title: Find female patients aged 50 or older at the time of their laboratory test
question: Find female patients aged 50 or older at the time of their laboratory test who were admitted to the hospital and have either abnormal red blood cell counts or abnormal fibrinogen levels. Return their ID, admission status, RBC, and FG values.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  T1."XCL_058",
  T3."XCL_013",
  T2."XCL_019",
  T2."XCL_036"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_001"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND T2."XCL_016" >= 50
  AND T3."XCL_013" > 0
  AND (T2."XCL_019" < 400 OR T2."XCL_019" > 500 OR T2."XCL_036" < 200 OR T2."XCL_036" > 400)
